description_for_human: AI-powered worksheet generator for English teachers. Create personalized ESL/EFL worksheets with 29 exercise types in seconds.
description_for_model: Edooqoo is an AI-powered platform for English language teachers. It generates personalized worksheets with 29 exercise types (reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, multiple choice, true/false, matching, dialogue practice, error correction, paraphrasing, sentence transformation, listening comprehension, picture description, and more) for CEFR levels A1 through C2. Features include: automatic AI grading of student homework, smart flashcards with SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm, 49-question AI placement test with speaking and listening components, Student Hub portal for independent student learning, lesson calendar with Google Calendar sync and Google Meet integration, nano-skill student progress tracking with CEFR tags, live session mode for real-time teaching, and worksheet sharing via permanent links. Designed for private English tutors, ESL/EFL instructors, Business English coaches, language school teachers, and corporate language trainers.
